item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
It seems that not many people have commented on the story written by Redd, which is a shame as it really left a greater impact then the backstory of Ruiz and Pico.
How much of Redd's story is fabrication, how much is allegory, how much is literal?
The Toyman went back to sleep.
The Doctor died a little inside.
Is doctor wondertainment literally two individuals, a doctor and a toymaker? Is doctor wondertainment suffering from a split personality disorder of sorts? If not, as Redd says "Doctor Wondertainment was not a real doctor", then who is the Doctor? Was Redd a doctor before becoming a little mister?

What is the motive of the Doctor? He's the one who presses the button which seems to either indicate a resetting of time of sorts, or perhaps it indicates that time has passed and "Jessie" has been called for.
Its also perhaps worth noting that Jessie is ultimately harmed every time he presses the button, does the doctor know that this will happen and he is pressing it for it to happen? Id doubt that based on the last line.

Additionally, the line
Jessie moved over to The Doctor, crossing her legs as she sat on his desk
seems rather insidious to me, due to the two assumptions, one that she was sitting on the desk facing wondertainment, and two she was dressed like a stereotypical secretary
